skill.displayName: 标前分析助手-投标前必查的一份报告

version.changelog:
· 修复 Windows 环境下首次使用可能注册失败的问题
· 精简设备信息采集，仅保留 3 项非身份属性
· 优化余额不足时的提示与充值引导

llm.summary: The skill mostly matches its pre-bid analysis purpose, but it needs review because it fingerprints devices for auto-registration, stores credentials and reports locally, and preserves signed access links in shareable reports.

dimensions.detail: Remote API calls are expected for this data product, but transmitting a stable hashed MAC-derived identifier and using bearer-style signed URLs are broader than needed for ordinary pre-bid analysis.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The manifest only declares the ZLBX_API_KEY environment requirement, while the instructions disclose network use, user-file reads, report writes, and ~/.zlbx credential storage in the skill text.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Registration is gated on user consent and cost is disclosed, but full HTML report generation is default in full mode and signed sk links are required to be preserved without a clear per-report sharing warning.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill writes API credentials to ~/.zlbx/config.json and generates reports under ~/zlbx-bid-decision-files/; there is no background persistence or destructive behavior, but persistence is not clearly opt-in each time.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The bid-analysis workflow is coherent, but the bundled account creation, hashed MAC/device identifier collection, local credential storage, and signed-link preservation expand the skill beyond simple analysis.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with this provider creating or using a local account, storing an API key under your home directory, saving bid reports locally by default, and including signed access links in reports. Prefer setting your own ZLBX_API_KEY in advance to avoid auto-registration and review generated reports before sharing them.
llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: Local reads of user-provided bid files and local report writes are expected for the stated workflow, but the metadata under-declares those capabilities compared with the artifact instructions.
[SDI-1] unexpected: The auto-registration and recharge/login workflow is disclosed and consent-gated, but account provisioning and credential management are a material expansion beyond bid analysis.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The auto-registration path collects platform, architecture, and a hashed MAC value; hashing reduces exposure, but it remains a stable device-linked identifier.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The artifact describes the hashed MAC feature as non-identifying, which underplays its use as a persistent device correlation value.
[SDI-2] unexpected: The report instructions require preserving sk signed links in conversation output and HTML reports; linking to source records is expected, but preserving access-bearing parameters in shareable reports is overbroad.
[SQP-2] expected: HTML report generation is purpose-aligned, but making it default in full mode without an explicit pre-write prompt creates a local data exposure concern.
[SQP-2] expected: Sending X-API-Key to the documented service endpoint is expected for the API integration; this is downgraded because the skill also instructs not to put credentials in user replies.
[E1] unexpected: The JSON POST guidance supports the disclosed auto-registration flow, but the transmitted device-derived registration metadata is not necessary for the core analysis task.
[E1] unexpected: The curl example is another implementation path for the same registration transmission; the concern is the device-data workflow, not curl usage itself.
